title: Word Formation: Przedrostek i koncowka naraz (krok 3)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Tu potrzebne sa dwie zmiany naraz: przedrostek przeczacy ORAZ koncowka. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna.

items.sentence: The evidence is __________ - he was clearly in the room.
The size of the universe is almost __________.
Her handwriting was __________ even to her own teacher.
The twins are __________ unless you hear them speak.
Her talent is __________ - no other player comes close.
A good map is __________ when you are walking in the mountains.
Rising __________ is the biggest worry for school leavers.
It is __________ that the earth goes round the sun.
